671-1580-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
671-1580-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Daxos and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1477-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1477-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat
2263-4247-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7154.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

240-3899-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1874-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3257-5686-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

301-1453-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

489-1090-1895-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

789-1263-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3043-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-5295.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6138.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Bloodboil Sorcerer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

2590-5776-6965-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7782.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Clockwork Hydra enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1127-3152-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
1127-3152-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1818-1981-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1818-1981-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2511-4785.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

510-2281-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2107-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
2107-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Sunastian Falconer
2107-5149-5200.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.
2107-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

5544-5670-5933.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
5544-5670-5933.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Popular Egotist triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Popular Egotist ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

132-4222-5116.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

1651-2410-3852.notablePrerequisites:
Leaden Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional Myr artifact creatures.
1651-2410-3852.description:
Activate Leaden Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two other Myr artifact creatures you control, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Repeat.
If you control another Myr that can tap to produce at least {1}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4050-4516-4556.notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
4050-4516-4556.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Blight Mound trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {R}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain one life.
Repeat.

1950-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
The number of Squirrels on the battlefield is greater than Scurry Oak's power.
1950-4186.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that gets +1/+1 for each other Squirrel on the battlefield.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Scurry Oak's evolve ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

1232-1322-3430-4289.description:
Activate Nemata by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Saproling by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

627-1021-2034-3470.description:
Play Drownyard Temple triggering landfall.
Use Lotus Cobra to gain {G} and Embodiment of Fury to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Repeat.

1274-1308-2034-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-1308-2034-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

269-910-1494.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours has the lowest toughness or is tied for the lowest toughness among creatures you control.
269-910-1494.description:
Cast Sandsteppe Mastodon by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Sandsteppe Mastodon enters the battlefield, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the begging of your upkeep, Stampeding Serow triggers, causing you to return Sandsteppe Mastodon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
